data.name: Proxy Project Ouroboros
data.detailed_description:
Steam Deck Compatible!

The game is now Steam Deck compatible so you can play it anywhere you go!


About the Game

EPILEPSY WARNING: This game contains flashing lights and patterns, please consider this before playing.

Now compatible with Steam Deck!

Need something challenging and fun that you can pick up and put down whenever you want with no strings attatched? That's why I made this fast paced, chaotic 3D reimagining of the classic Snake game, built around endless waves, changing strategies and deep customization, but keeping those classic goals, to have a great time and beat the highest score! No micro transactions, no battle passes, just play whenever you want and come back whenever you want!

Take control of the Ouroboros Proxies and consume all the rogue AI critters, each wave event introduces new critter behaviors and each map new ways of playing, from jumping and boosting on land to catch flying beetles, to floating and diving in water to catch teleporting mice, every wave feels like a completely different experience, so stay sharp and adapt quickly!

You can also play with a friend in local Split Screen either next to each other or using Steam's Remote Play Together, or solo, at home or on the go with your Steam Deck! You can also heavily tweak the experience with multiple customizing menus to better fit your hardware, your time, your skill level and even your style, everything from critters per wave and snake material customization, to the individual graphics settings!

Story:
You are a newly hired Proxy Tester at Paradigm Shift, a company developing robotic vessels for human consciousness, your job: Test the experimental Ouroboros model against disposable AI units and find out just how well a human mind can adapt to a body that was never meant to inhabit.

Developer Note:
This is my first game, and it was entirely built by me from the ground up, except for the vegetation in the temple because I really liked it and the music, which is Copyright Free, I altered it a bit in Audacity to better fit the game but it's still Copyright Free in my YouTube Channel with a link to the original, I plan to keep improving this game based on player feedback, so if you enjoy it, or have ideas, I’d love to hear from you. :)

data.short_description: A 3D local splitscreen reimagining of the snake game (can be played single player too), as an infinite wave based score attack where you have to eat different rogue critters whose AI changes depending on the current level event in the chosen map, with deep customization in both looks and gameplay.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10100 or AMD Ryzen 3 3100 or lower
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 560 or lower
  • Storage: 1460 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum still unknown, these are the Steam Deck stats and it still runs at max
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-9300H CPU @ 2.40GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce ® GTX 1650
  • Storage: 1460 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recomended still unknown, this runs max graphics flawlessly
